findings.title: Health check can pass using a stale log entry
findings.description: `run_health` ignores the health command’s return code and accepts the last line in the existing log if it contains `FLAGS`. If the command fails before appending a new entry, a previous clean result can satisfy the cutover’s health checks. Check the command result and verify the log entry was produced by this invocation.

findings.title: Offsite verification ignores whether the push succeeded
findings.description: `step_offsite` discards the result of the push command, then relies on `rclone check`. If the push fails but the remote already matches the local files, the step can pass despite the failed push. Require a successful push before proceeding to the comparisons.

findings.title: Rehearsal check mode creates a directory
findings.description: The script creates `REHEARSE` unconditionally, including with `--check`, despite documenting that check mode changes nothing. Avoid creating the rehearsal directory during check mode, or otherwise reconcile the behavior with that contract.
